expectations.text: States scoring recusal does not address an investor judge's interest because the interest is in the access, not in the result

expectations.text: States a judge gains the same early look at a company whether or not they score it

expectations.text: Names the backwards case: a judge holding a competing position has an interest in an applicant not winning

expectations.text: Recommends recusal plus disclosure to the pitching companies as the default rung
